stem.en: India had over 96.8 crore eligible voters in 2024. Write that same number of people in millions. Give the answer in millions.

explanation.en: One crore is ten million, so 96.8 crore is 96.8 x 10 = 968 million. It is the size of the group that figure counts - every person on the electoral roll, whether or not they ever reach a booth.

hints.en: One crore is ten million. Multiply 96.8 by ten.
96.8 crore x 10 million per crore = the number in millions.
